readScope: Complete apply-description-clarifications.py read. All six selected audit proposals extracted and their exact replacement excerpts/following access qualifications read; en-US exactBefore plus alternativeNarrower read. Full before/after replacement identity checked locally. No script execution, asc_report import, API call or plan-state certification.

excerptReview.beforeExcerpt: Partagez des événements et des calendriers, puis envoyez des invitations par e-mail, code QR ou App Clip.
excerptReview.afterExcerpt: Partagez des événements et des calendriers avec des invitations par e-mail ou code QR. App Clip propose un aperçu de l’événement ; pour l’ajouter à un calendrier depuis cet aperçu, il faut l’app complète.
excerptReview.retainedAccessQualification: Les droits d’accès dépendent du calendrier et du type d’invitation.

excerptReview.beforeExcerpt: Condividi eventi e calendari e invia inviti tramite email, codice QR o App Clip.
excerptReview.afterExcerpt: Condividi eventi e calendari con inviti tramite email o codice QR. App Clip mostra un’anteprima dell’evento; per aggiungerlo a un calendario da questa anteprima serve l’app completa.
excerptReview.retainedAccessQualification: I permessi dipendono dal calendario e dal tipo di invito.

excerptReview.beforeExcerpt: イベントやカレンダーを共有し、メール、QRコード、App Clipで招待できます。
excerptReview.afterExcerpt: メールやQRコードによる招待で、イベントやカレンダーを共有できます。App Clipではイベントのプレビューを確認できます。このプレビューからカレンダーにイベントを追加するには、フルアプリが必要です。
excerptReview.retainedAccessQualification: アクセス権はカレンダーや招待の種類によって異なります。

excerptReview.beforeExcerpt: 이벤트와 캘린더를 공유하고 이메일, QR 코드 또는 App Clip으로 초대하세요.
excerptReview.afterExcerpt: 이메일이나 QR 코드 초대로 이벤트와 캘린더를 공유하세요. App Clip에서는 이벤트를 미리 볼 수 있습니다. 이 미리보기에서 캘린더에 이벤트를 추가하려면 전체 앱이 필요합니다.
excerptReview.retainedAccessQualification: 접근 권한은 캘린더와 초대 유형에 따라 다릅니다.

excerptReview.beforeExcerpt: Compartilhe eventos e calendários e envie convites por e-mail, código QR ou App Clip.
excerptReview.afterExcerpt: Compartilhe eventos e calendários com convites por e-mail ou código QR. O App Clip mostra uma prévia do evento; para adicioná-lo a um calendário a partir dessa prévia, é necessário o app completo.
excerptReview.retainedAccessQualification: As permissões dependem do calendário e do tipo de convite.

excerptReview.beforeExcerpt: Deel evenementen en kalenders en nodig anderen uit via e-mail, een QR-code of een App Clip.
excerptReview.afterExcerpt: Deel evenementen en kalenders met uitnodigingen via e-mail of een QR-code. App Clip toont een voorbeeld van het evenement; om het vanuit dat voorbeeld aan een kalender toe te voegen, is de volledige app nodig.
excerptReview.retainedAccessQualification: Toegangsrechten hangen af van de kalender en het type uitnodiging.

excerptReview.beforeExcerpt: Share events and calendars, and send invitations by email, QR code or App Clip.
excerptReview.afterExcerpt: Share events and calendars with email or QR invitations. App Clip offers an event preview; adding the event through that experience requires the full app.
excerptReview.retainedAccessQualification: Sharing access depends on the calendar and invitation type.

meaning: All seven explain App Clip event preview separately from adding via the full app. None promises no-install adding, universal availability, instant handoff, security or receipt/RSVP. Narrow event wording is truthful even though current source also has calendar-invitation preview; omission of that extra preview is not a blocker.

scriptReview.targets: Seven distinct locale descriptions, each <=4000 characters. Exact excerpt occurs once; computed after must equal before.replace(excerpt).
scriptReview.draftGuards: Version and app-info states fetched and required PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION; versionString1.7.4. Rechecked before each target and after. IDs come from saved snapshot; does not discover arbitrary draft IDs.
scriptReview.concurrency: Initial actual description must equal known before or after. Per-target complete current attributes must equal initial snapshot before patch. No unsupported claim of fully atomic read/write locking.
scriptReview.mutationSurface: PATCH payload contains description only. No submission/build/price/privacy/name/URL operation in this script. No writes unless --apply.
scriptReview.preservation: Postread requires same50locale set, all app-info locale records unchanged, each version-localization attribute equal before except intended seven descriptions, and version attributes/draft state unchanged.
scriptReview.idempotency: Already-after descriptions skip patch but still verify.
scriptReview.reporting: Prewrite report saved, updated after each successful patch; allVerified set only after complete postread assertions.

operationalLimits: Static review does not certify actual plan API state or API outcomes; root inspects plan evidence.
Sequential PATCH operations are not transactional. If a later guard fails, earlier successful changes may remain and writes report records them; inspect before retrying.
A tiny read-to-write race remains because no conditional API write is used; per-target guard and final full readback detect observed divergence but are not a locking guarantee.
Exact released App Store1.7.3/App Clip behavior remains unverified; this is a draft1.7.4 semantic proposal tied to current inspected source.
Translation review is bounded cross-agent review, not native-speaker certification.
noActions: No API requests/writes, source edits, commits, builds, deployment or messages sent. Only this review artifact written.
